scope: same physical-family unseen-cell future SOH; no current-SOH or independent RUL
target: comparable discharge capacity / initial comparable reference capacity, SOH 0-1
main_input: V/I/T early signal prefixes, known specifications/conditions, source cycle and requested future horizon; no measured capacity, SOH, actual EOL or future signal
split_strata: known charging/discharging conditions plus batch as provenance-balancing stratum, never final life or labels
physical_routing: separate family-specific predictors; optional shared encoder later must retain compatible family-specific heads
nasa: 4-cell LOBO supplementary only; isolated unverified physical cohort

smoke.purpose: engineering sanity, not a five-fold five-seed accuracy claim

existing_public_data_status: previously inspected development data, not independent blind testing
